The uniform-grid thin world crashed at 0xC83D0E reading 0xC twice in p0fix2-1127; the grow-paint thin 4096 world passed its load in p0fix6-1127. Same pins and keys. atlas-8192-patches-1126: Boundless Atlas 8192 m in-memory patches (its docs/026; designs its docs/008 B1-B3, docs/010, docs/019), atlas.asi 0.2.1-w8192 with [World8192] Routing=1, PaintIndex=1, PhysicsRoot=1. NOT RUN: prepared 2026-11-26, other jobs had the game. DEPENDS ON feature/atlas-p0-load-1126 being merged first: the queue.ts key extraAsi with tools/harness/extra-asi.ts, the defaultIni read-back, the repro atlas-p0-load-2048 and the Bin restore in tools/turbo-compat.ts come from that branch; this branch (based on master) adds only this file and the repro atlas-8192-load-thinu-8192 (both branches append to repros.json: keep both entries at the merge). Dry-run 2026-11-26 on a throwaway merge of the two branches. Correctness / discovery, no timing claim. Bin state apex (tools/turbo-compat.ts snapshot -> state apex -> restore). PREP (game closed, all outside git): boundless-atlas native/atlas/build.cmd, copy out/atlas.asi to <s3m>/game-copy/atlas-main3/atlas.asi and put its sha256 into every job when it was rebuilt (the pinned bytes are 0.2.1-w8192, the build of 2026-11-26 19:23:09 from Atlas fa2967b (rule-review fixes, Atlas docs/026 §10: routing stubs keep SSE / x87, site graphs, rollback, read-fail exits, v3 save guards), paged-lot probe included and off, self-check 210 of 210, p1 29 of 29); node tools/world-empty.ts build "<s3m>/game-copy/worlds/Sunset Valley.world" <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasP0thinU_8192.world --size 8192 --thin --uniform-grid; back up <Documents>/Electronic Arts/The Sims 3; node tools/world-gen.ts install for AtlasP0thin_2048.world and AtlasP0thinU_8192.world. AFTER: the same with --uninstall. WORLD GATE: the 8192 m jobs wait until a generated or CAW-made world of that size loads at all (Atlas docs/014: the thin 8192 m world without the uniform grid crashed at 0xC2C1B5; the uniform-grid 4096 m load is job 3 of atlas-p0-caw-1126 on the P0 branch). Job 1 needs no large world and can run first. Read from each job log: the atlas.log lines (one per site: installed / skipped (reason)), the w8192 counters line, memory lines, script errors, crash / hang capture. Every job forbids in atlas.log (extraAsi.logForbid, from the P0 branch's queue.ts): a 'w8192 routing: fallback' line, FAILED, (PARTIAL), 'self-check: FAIL', READ-BACK DIFFERS and 'w8192: SKIP'; so an early counters line with fallback 0 cannot pass a job that falls back later. Every job keeps the mod's PortalFlagRefs rule (required in jobs 1-2, forbidden in 3-4). Jobs 1-3 do NOT prove a chunk above 16,383 read back (the thin world has waypoints only up to chunk 16,191) or a version-4 paint map; job 4 is for both. STRIP WORLD (job 4, added 2026-11-26, dry-run only, Atlas docs/026 §9): node tools/world-empty.ts build <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasCawFlat_4096.world <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasStrip_8192.world --size 8192 --strip (built 2026-11-26 19:04, 161,800,602 bytes, sha256 ca2fe15a64cd1961eeb78842caa39ae15a641cad6c77a64af1623b45c03cdc74; node tools/world-empty.ts check <file> --size 8192 --strip must print rules OK), then node tools/world-gen.ts install for it. It is the CAW-made flat 4096 m world (4 empty lots, no road, no Sim) grown to 8192 m: lots at (500, 3500) and (4000, 4000) sit in chunks 27,919 and 32,125, 3,973 of 6,998 waypoints are above chunk 16,383, and the paint map is format version 4 with 262,144 tiles. It does not load without PaintIndex=1 (a vanilla game refuses the version-4 map at the header check). No bisect on a failure: static triage first.
